sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and Technology remain the dominant market leaders, but broad market participation is nonexistent with zero of 11 sectors holding all-green breadth.

Market leadership remains heavily concentrated at the top. Energy (rank 1, momentum 0.850) and Technology (rank 2, momentum 0.783) continue to hold the highest ranks, with Technology demonstrating sustained multi-month strength. Meanwhile, incremental rotations favored defensive and commodity-linked sectors over the last five sessions, as Basic Materials, Consumer Defensive, and Communication Services each gained 1 spot.

Conversely, breadth is exceptionally narrow across the board, with no sector showing positive performance across all timeframes. Weakness is most acute in Real Estate (momentum 0.150) and Utilities (momentum 0.217), while cyclical and industrial groups are losing traction alongside fading momentum in Healthcare.

## Strength
- **Sustained Leadership:** Technology is the sole sector exhibiting sustained strength, consistently placing in the top 3 across 1-, 3-, and 6-month ranks with a momentum score of 0.783.
- **Top Overall Rank:** Energy commands the market lead at rank 1, posting the highest momentum score across all sectors at 0.850.
- **Zero All-Green Breadth:** Overall market breadth is fragile, with 0 of 11 sectors currently positive across the weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD horizons.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Five-Day Gainers:** Basic Materials (moved to rank 3, momentum 0.48), Consumer Defensive (moved to rank 5, momentum 0.63), and Communication Services (moved to rank 8, momentum 0.57) all advanced +1 spot over the last 5 sessions.
- **Five-Day Losers:** Healthcare fell to rank 6, Industrials dropped to rank 4 (momentum 0.47), and Real Estate slipped to rank 9, each losing 1 spot over 5 sessions.
- **Persistent Laggards:** Real Estate (0.150), Utilities (0.217, rank 10), and Consumer Cyclical (0.350, rank 11) remain rooted at the bottom of the momentum rankings.

## Divergences
- **Healthcare Fading:** Healthcare displays an early-warning negative divergence, shedding 1 rank spot over the last 5 sessions despite an otherwise elevated momentum score of 0.62.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and defensive staples dominate leadership, highlighted by Agricultural Inputs surging 103 spots, while rate-sensitive real estate and leisure remain pinned at the bottom.

Market breadth remains selective, with only 19 of 144 groups displaying all-green performance across all timeframes. Traditional energy leads the broader market, driven by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.999, rank 1 YTD) and Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.867, rank 9 YTD), with further sustained support in Marine Shipping and Consumer Electronics. 

Rotation is leaning defensive and agricultural, demonstrated by sharp five-day improvements in Agricultural Inputs (+103 spots to rank 35), Beverages - Brewers (+17 spots to rank 31), and Tobacco (+16 spots to rank 29). Conversely, real estate, travel, and rate-sensitive pockets are fading fast, with Real Estate - Development falling 17 spots to rank 92, and groups like Mortgage Finance (momentum 0.045) and REIT - Mortgage (momentum 0.050) anchoring the absolute bottom of momentum rankings.

## Strength
- **All-Green Leadership:** 19 of 144 groups maintain positive returns across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD, led by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 1.00), Communication Equipment (momentum 0.90), and Marine Shipping (momentum 0.90).
- **Sustained Performers:** Groups holding top-36 ranks across 1, 3, and 6-month windows include Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing, Marine Shipping, Consumer Electronics, Tobacco, Electronics & Computer Distribution, Insurance - Reinsurance, Diagnostics & Research, and Software - Infrastructure.
- **Top Absolute Momentum:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing holds the #1 YTD rank with a 0.999 momentum score, followed by Communication Equipment (0.901, rank 6 YTD) and Marine Shipping (0.896, rank 5 YTD).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-Day Gainers:** Agricultural Inputs jumped +103 spots to rank 35 (momentum 0.55), followed by Beverages - Brewers (+17 spots to rank 31, momentum 0.74) and Tobacco (+16 spots to rank 29, momentum 0.86).
- **Top 5-Day Decliners:** Real Estate - Development dropped -17 spots to rank 92 (momentum 0.21), Shell Companies fell -16 spots to rank 45 (momentum 0.65), and Pharmaceutical Retailers slipped -12 spots to rank 128 (momentum 0.28).
- **Momentum Laggards:** Underperformance is concentrated in Mortgage Finance (momentum 0.045, rank 142 YTD), REIT - Mortgage (momentum 0.050, rank 135 YTD), and Airports & Air Services (momentum 0.085, rank 140 YTD).

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Groups:** Shell Companies dropped 16 spots over 5 days despite a 0.65 momentum score; Diagnostics & Research (momentum 0.79) slipped 3 spots, and Department Stores (momentum 0.73) declined 3 spots.
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Movers:** Insurance - Specialty climbed +8 spots in 5 sessions despite low momentum (0.39), while Utilities - Independent Power Producers rose +7 spots (momentum 0.46) and Consulting Services gained +6 spots (momentum 0.36).
